sources.title: xbill9/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it-qat-q4_0-w4a16-ct · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Google publishes compressed-tensors W4A16 QAT checkpoints for Gemma 4 E2B, E4B, 12B and 31B. Its QAT model card lists none for 26B-A4B, which ships as Q4_0 GGUF and as a 48 GiB bf16 export.

sources.title: google/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Gemma 4 features a context window of up to 256K tokens and maintains multilingual support in over 140 languages. Featuring both Dense and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures, Gemma 4 is well-suited for tasks like text generation, coding, and reasoning. The models are available in five distinct sizes: E2B, E4B, 12B, 26B A4B, and 31B.

sources.title: Gemma 4 — Google DeepMind
sources.snippet: Gemma 4 models undergo the same rigorous infrastructure security protocols as our proprietary models.
